value.rationale: The model has a natural but previously unmeasured genealogy: the birth time of particles at the spatial frontier. The leading founders are concentrated near startup on an unusual \(t/\log t\) scale; the exact conditional finite-t law and ranked independent exponential marks quantify this effect beyond the known maximum. This gives interpretable, nontrivial marked-extreme structure rather than a rephrasing of the Gumbel marginal.
